cards.source_sentence: 제 최애는 BTS의 지민이에요.
cards.translation: My favorite member (my bias) is Jimin from BTS.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.prompt: 친구는 이 무대를 보고 그 그룹에 ___.
cards.source_sentence: 친구는 이 무대를 보고 그 그룹에 입덕했어요.
cards.translation: My friend became a fan of the group after seeing this performance.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.target_translation: fandom activities; following a favorite artist
cards.source_sentence: 저는 주말마다 좋아하는 그룹의 덕질을 해요.
cards.translation: I spend my weekends following my favorite group.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.prompt: 콘서트가 끝난 뒤에 지민의 ___ 다시 봤어요.
cards.source_sentence: 콘서트가 끝난 뒤에 지민의 직캠을 다시 봤어요.
cards.translation: After the concert, I watched Jimin's fancam again.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 그룹의 컴백이 다음 달로 정해졌어요.
cards.translation: The group's comeback is scheduled for next month.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 공연이 시작되자 관객들이 응원봉을 켰어요.
cards.translation: When the concert began, the audience switched on their lightsticks.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.prompt: 이 그룹은 여러 나라에 큰 ___ 있어요.
cards.source_sentence: 이 그룹은 여러 나라에 큰 팬덤이 있어요.
cards.translation: This group has a large fanbase in many countries.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.prompt: 그 그룹의 ___ 무대가 큰 화제가 됐어요.
cards.source_sentence: 그 그룹의 데뷔 무대가 큰 화제가 됐어요.
cards.translation: The group's debut performance became a major talking point.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 우리 그룹의 막내는 춤을 잘 춰요.
cards.translation: The youngest member of our group is a good dancer.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 새 앨범에 열두 곡이 들어 있어요.
cards.translation: The new album contains twelve songs.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 이번 에피소드의 결말이 정말 놀라웠어요.
cards.translation: The ending of this episode really surprised me.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 새 시즌은 다음 달에 공개돼요.
cards.translation: The new season will be released next month.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 마지막 장면에서 눈물이 났어요.
cards.translation: I cried during the final scene.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 배우들은 촬영 전에 대본을 함께 읽어요.
cards.translation: The actors read the script together before filming.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.prompt: 그 ___ 새 드라마에서 의사 역할을 맡았어요.
cards.source_sentence: 그 배우는 새 드라마에서 의사 역할을 맡았어요.
cards.translation: The actor plays a doctor in the new drama.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 감독은 촬영 전에 배우들과 장면을 연습해요.
cards.translation: The director rehearses the scenes with the actors before filming.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.prompt: 드라마 ___ 다음 회에 새로운 인물을 소개했어요.
cards.source_sentence: 드라마 작가가 다음 회에 새로운 인물을 소개했어요.
cards.translation: The drama's writer introduces a new character in the next episode.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 새 드라마 예고편이 어제 공개됐어요.
cards.translation: The new drama's trailer was released yesterday.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 저는 예상하지 못한 결말을 보고 놀랐어요.
cards.translation: I was surprised by the unexpected ending.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.prompt: 이 드라마에서는 ___ 친구를 찾으러 서울로 떠나요.
cards.source_sentence: 이 드라마에서는 주인공이 친구를 찾으러 서울로 떠나요.
cards.translation: In this drama, the main character leaves for Seoul to find a friend.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 콘서트 마지막 무대가 정말 대박이었어요.
cards.translation: The concert’s final performance was incredible.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 헐, 이 카페는 새벽까지 열어요?
cards.translation: Whoa, is this café open until dawn?
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 친구가 추천한 예능 프로그램이 정말 꿀잼이었어요.
cards.translation: The variety show my friend recommended was so much fun.
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.source_sentence: 이 떡볶이 진짜 존맛이야.

cards.answer_form: Vulgar slang; avoid formal settings and elders
cards.source_label: Editor-reviewed Korean example

cards.prompt: 그 농담 뒤에 단체 채팅방 분위기가 ___ 됐어요.
